notes: Highveld grassland, Gauteng marshes and the Drakensberg: Wakkerstroom, Verloren Vallei, Dullstroom, the escarpment and Magaliesberg. Hand-picked from the South Africa species the country trip does not have; Ground Woodpecker, Drakensberg Rockjumper, Drakensberg Siskin and Prinia, Eastern Long-billed Lark, Buff-streaked Chat, Sentinel Rock Thrush, Gurney's Sugarbird, Blue Crane, Grey Crowned Crane, Southern Bald Ibis and Cape Vulture are already in the trip. Left to other packs to keep every bird in one place: Gauteng and Highveld waterbirds and waders to Fynbos and Natal (African Rail, African Snipe, Maccoa Duck, Southern Pochard, Hottentot Teal, Black-necked Grebe), White Stork and Lesser Kestrel to Fynbos, Black Stork, Striped Pipit, Quailfinch, Jameson's Firefinch, Cinnamon-breasted Bunting, Pearl-breasted Swallow and Eurasian Hobby to Lowveld, Barratt's Warbler to Garden Route, and the Karoo birds (Temminck's Courser, Monotonous Lark, Black-chested Prinia, Cinnamon-breasted Warbler, Black-throated Canary, Greater Kestrel, Orange River Francolin, Verreaux's Eagle-Owl). Blue Bustard (Karoo), Denham's Bustard and Cape Eagle Owl (Fynbos) are kept here on purpose: Wakkerstroom and the Drakensberg are where a visitor looks for them. Left out for lack of usable photos or a safe ID from photos: Yellow-tufted Pipit (yetpip1), Flappet Lark (flalar1), African Grass-Owl (afgowl1), Common Reed Warbler and Marsh Warbler (eurwar1, marwar3), Burnt-necked Eremomela (bunere1), African Crake, Baillon's Crake, Striped Flufftail, Short-tailed Pipit, Western House Martin, Sand Martin, Little Sparrowhawk, Yellow-throated Bush Sparrow, Common Swift, Greater Honeyguide. Not in the database for South Africa: Black Sparrowhawk and Burchell's Coucal.
